Name: Compressed Horse
Author: chromamods
Description:
[size=5][b]Compressed Horse[/b][/size]
[i]Make your horse have skinny thoughts.[/i]

Vanilla horses need a two-tile gap, which means some spaces you try and squeeze through you just get blocked. This mod makes horses fit through any spaces you can walk through. The horse looks the exact same, you can just squeeze through where you could not before.

[b]Optional:[/b] walk through parked horses (off by default), so yours can't trap you in your own doorway. Toggle it in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ on Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]This mod is safe to add or remove mid-save. If you're playing multiplayer, all players need it.

Manifest.Name: Compressed Horse
Manifest.Description: Slims the ridden horse's hitbox to the farmer's width so it fits through one-tile gaps. Optionally lets players walk through parked horses.
Manifest.Author: ChromaMods
